name: classic-geode-green-lie
_comment: GEODE_GREEN_CONFIRM self-disarm -- the mis-calibrated green pixel. Green confirm is ON and the dig-bar pixel is NEVER painted (the user pointed 'Green dig pixel' at the wrong place), but the digs genuinely register: the capacity reaches FULL at 2600, after the whole GEODE_START_TRIES tap budget has already gone by unproven. That is the one-time calibration probe -- the leg pays the GEODE_DELAY_MS animation, the bar HAS moved, so the green pixel is the thing that is wrong. State.geode_green_ok latches False, State.recal_reason is set for the app's red recalibrate flag, and the run reverts to the plain geode path (never fast-failing a good dig off a bad pixel). Without this proof the same world would nudge away from perfectly good land every round until STUCK_LIMIT safe-stopped the run. The quit lands inside go_water's key hold after the confirmed dig. Companion to classic-geode-green-miss; same vendoring rules.
_screen_comment: Whole-box capacity paint (see classic-shards): keyframes are 0/1 only. The dig-trigger pixel is never painted -- that IS the mis-calibration this scenario models.
